title: The Ballad Of John And Yoko
lyrics_synced:
[00:05.76] Standing in the dock at Southampton.
[00:09.60] Trying to get to Holland or France!
[00:13.20] The man in the mac said,
[00:15.12] "You've got to turn back"!
[00:16.56] You know they didn't even give us a chance!
[00:19.44] Christ you know it ain't easy!
[00:23.28] You know how hard it can be!
[00:27.60] The way things are going
[00:30.96] they're going to crucify me!
[00:36.48] Finally made the plane into Paris!
[00:40.32] Honey mooning down by the Seine!
[00:43.44] Peter Brown called to say
[00:45.60] "You can make it O.K.!
[00:47.28] You can get married in Gibraltar, near Spain".
[00:50.16] Christ you know it ain't easy!
[00:54.00] You know how hard it can be!
[00:58.32] The way things are going
[01:01.68] they're going to crucify me!
[01:06.48] Drove from Paris to the Amsterdam Hilton.
[01:11.04] Talking in our beds for a week!
[01:14.64] The newspapers said, "Say what you doing in bed?"
[01:18.00] I said, "We're only trying to get us some peace!".
[01:20.88] Christ you know it ain't easy!
[01:24.72] You know how hard it can be!
[01:29.04] The way things are going
[01:32.40] they're going to crucify me!
[01:37.92] Saving up your money for a rainy day!
[01:41.76] Giving all your clothes to charity!
[01:45.60] Last night the wife said!
[01:47.52] "Oh boy, when you're dead
[01:49.20] you don't take nothing with you
[01:50.88] but your soul, think!"
[01:54.24] Made a lightning trip to Vienna
[01:58.08] eating chocolate cake in a bag!
[02:01.68] The newspapers said, "She's gone to his head,

[02:07.92] Christ you know it ain't easy!
